description:
# Compliance child for opi-q5k.40 (opi-q5k.5 / editor.test.ts)

## Scope

Upstream L369-394: 3 integration tests for Kitty CSI-u key events reaching the editor. Our stdin_fsm_test.exs covers the parser level. Verify that our Input handles the parsed events correctly for at least: Kitty press event, Kitty release event (ignored for non-repeat), batched press+release.

## Protocol

1. Read tmp/pi-mono/packages/tui/test/editor.test.ts; locate the "Kitty CSI-u handling" describe.
2. Enumerate every it(...) under that describe.
3. For each, find or confirm absent an equivalent Elixir assertion in apps/octo_pi_tui/test/octo_pi/tui/components/input_test.exs (grep if unsure).
4. Implement any missing behavior in OctoPi.TUI.Components.Input (or related modules).
5. Port the missing tests to input_test.exs (under a new describe "editor-parity: Kitty CSI-u handling" or integrated with existing describes where they fit).
6. Re-read tmp/pi-mono editor.test.ts "Kitty CSI-u handling" top-to-bottom and confirm every it(...) has an Elixir equivalent.
7. Post a final comment documenting the mapping (upstream test → Elixir test).
8. Close this child.

## Deps
Blocks opi-q5k.40 (which blocks opi-q5k.1).

comments.text: Upstream tests 3 editor-level integration cases with Kitty CSI-u events. In our architecture the parsing happens in OctoPi.TUI.StdinFSM (stdin_fsm_test.exs describe 'Kitty keyboard protocol' — 9 tests) and OctoPi.TUI.KeyParser (key_parser_test.exs describes 'Kitty CSI-u' and 'Kitty CSI-u — alternate layouts' — 30+ tests). Input receives normalized Key structs, so editor-level Kitty integration is transitively covered. No new tests required.

title: editor.test.ts / Kitty CSI-u handling (3 upstream tests)
